verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a public pricing page that names several cost drivers. It states 'Unlimited seats… pricing is based on usage', defines a billable 'AI Run' (tracked LLM requests and online evals), and lists usage allowances such as 5K session replays and 5K errors per month. A community comment adds that client SDK usage is charged by MAU, but the pricing-page evidence does not confirm MAU as the primary usage metric, and no actual price figures are shown. Missing for 10: published dollar amounts per plan or per unit, first-party confirmation of the core flag-usage metric (MAUs or service connections), and overage or tier thresholds.
